newsitem.title: SPAIN: Aznar says Spain will be rigorous with budget.
newsitem.headline: Aznar says Spain will be rigorous with budget.

text.p: Prime Minister Jose Maria Aznar said on Friday Spain would be especially rigorous in reaching its deficit target.
He also warned of future market speculation seeking to capsize the single currency boat as the date for European economic and monetary union approaches.
"We have to finish going down the path that allows us to participate in the single currency from the beginning," Aznar said at an EMU conference.

"Nobody should think that the path will be easy or that the boat is not going to move or that there won't be those who will try to move the boat or the waters. There will be many attempts... but what is important is that we don't lose direction," Aznar said.
